originalWork: ItemAssembly.png is the reference-derived blank shared chassis. ItemAssembly.gdshader drives its authored gauge ticks; ItemHudSlot draws live optional resource bars. Existing SVG item icons remain placeholders for downstream item-specific visual Stories.
Wrench.svg, Missile.svg, Oil.svg, Nitro.svg, Salvo.svg and MachineGun.svg are project-created silhouettes; no external assets were acquired for these silhouettes.
Component.gdshader preserves the source textures and masks example values at runtime.
